verses.sloka: ताम्स्तु ते सम्प्रक्ष्यामि प्रेक्षमाणस्य यूथपान् ।राघव अर्थे पराक्रान्ता ये न रक्षन्ति जीवितम् ॥६-२७-१॥।।
verses.transliteration: tāmstu te samprakṣyāmi prekṣamāṇasya yūthapān ।rāghava arthe parākrāntā ye na rakṣanti jīvitam ॥6-27-1॥।।

translations.english: "I will describe the Vanara force, who are not caring for their lives for the cause of Raghava. You may see."
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्ड का छंब्बीसवाँ सग पूरा हुआ । ---8 याया ट ति सप्तविंशः सगः य त 'स्तु तेऽहं प्रवक्धयामि प्रेक्षमाणस्य यूथपान्‌ । -घवार्थे पराक्रान्ता ये न रबन्ति जीवितम्‌

verses.sloka: स्निग्धा यस्य बहु श्यामा बाला लान्गूलम् आश्रिताः ।ताम्राः पीताः सिताः श्वेताः प्रकीर्णा घोर कर्मणः ॥६-२७-२॥।।
verses.transliteration: snigdhā yasya bahu śyāmā bālā lāngūlam āśritāḥ ।tāmrāḥ pītāḥ sitāḥ śvetāḥ prakīrṇā ghora karmaṇaḥ ॥6-27-2॥।।

translations.english: "One who is of terrific action, whose long tail with plenty of hair of different colours like red, white, yellow with shining ends shining like the scattered rays of the rising sun is holding and dragging on the ground is a leader known as Hara."
translations.hindi: स्निग्धा यस्य बहुव्यामा& वाला लाइूलमार्थ्रित:। ह OQ 005 0 ताम्राः पीताः सिताः श्वेता: प्रकीशा घोरकमंण

verses.sloka: प्रगृहीताः प्रकाशन्ते सूर्यस्य इव मरीचयः ।पृथिव्याम् च अनुकृष्यन्ते हरो नाम एष यूथपः ॥६-२७-३॥।।
verses.transliteration: pragṛhītāḥ prakāśante sūryasya iva marīcayaḥ ।pṛthivyām ca anukṛṣyante haro nāma eṣa yūthapaḥ ॥6-27-3॥।।

translations.english: "One who is of terrific action, whose long tail with plenty of hair of different colours like red, white, yellow with shining ends shining like the scattered rays of the rising sun is holding and dragging on the ground is a leader known as Hara."
translations.hindi: और जो सूर्य की किरणों की तरह चमक रहे हें और जो पूंछ भटकारने से खड़े हो जाते और जो चलते समय भूमि पर लथिरते जाते हैं, सो वही हर नास यूथपति हं

verses.sloka: यम् पृष्ठतो अनुगच्चन्ति शतशो अथ सहस्रशः ।वृक्षानुद्यम्य सहसा लङ्का रोहणतत्पराः ॥६-२७-४॥।।
verses.transliteration: yam pṛṣṭhato anugaccanti śataśo atha sahasraśaḥ ।vṛkṣānudyamya sahasā laṅkā rohaṇatatparāḥ ॥6-27-4॥।।

translations.english: "Standing in attention near Sugriva are hundreds and thousands of warriors holding huge trees aspiring to climb Lanka and controlling the Vanaras at the back prominently and following."
translations.hindi: इसके ही पीछे सैकड़ों, हजारों बानरबीर चलते है जो वृक्षों को लिये हुए, सहसा लङ्का पर चढ वरन को तयार हूं

verses.sloka: यूथपा हरिराजस्य किम्कराः समुपस्थिताः ।नीलान् इव महामेघाम्स् तिष्ठतो याम्स् तु पश्यसि ॥६-२७-५॥।।
verses.transliteration: yūthapā harirājasya kimkarāḥ samupasthitāḥ ।nīlān iva mahāmeghāms tiṣṭhato yāms tu paśyasi ॥6-27-5॥।।

translations.english: "O King! Standing like dark clouds, black in colour like collyrium, who are of unfailing valour in war, innumerable in numbers, like the small particles of sand on the other bank of ocean, who cannot be counted are moving towards you. They are from mountains, riverbanks, and difficult locations. Those highly ferocious Bears are advancing towards you."
translations.hindi: हं परपुरञ्जय ! ये सहस्र कोटि बड़े बलवान्‌ वानर तुमको युद्ध में जीतने की आकांक्षा रखते हैं

verses.sloka: असितान् जन सम्काशान् युद्धे सत्य पराक्रमान् ।असम्ख्येयान् अनिर्देश्यान् परम् पारम् इव उदधेः ॥६-२७-६॥।।
verses.transliteration: asitān jana samkāśān yuddhe satya parākramān ।asamkhyeyān anirdeśyān param pāram iva udadheḥ ॥6-27-6॥।।

translations.english: "O King! Standing like dark clouds, black in colour like collyrium, who are of unfailing valour in war, innumerable in numbers, like the small particles of sand on the other bank of ocean, who cannot be counted are moving towards you. They are from mountains, riverbanks, and difficult locations. Those highly ferocious Bears are advancing towards you."
translations.hindi: कपिराज के ये सब किङ्कर यूथपति है ( वेतनभोगी यूथपति) और युद्ध करने के लिए उपस्थित हुए हैं हे रावण ! नील सघ की तरह आप जिनको खड़ा देखते हैँ और काले अञ्जन की तरह जिनके शरीर का रंग है और जो युद्ध में यथांथ पराक्रम प्रदर्शित किश्या करते/हैं, असंख्य हैं, समुद्र के अपर पार की तरह इनकी संख्या नहीं बतलाई जा सकती

verses.sloka: पर्वतेषु च ये केचिद् विषमेषु नदीषु च ।एते त्वाम् अभिवर्तन्ते राजन्न् ऋष्काः सुदारुणाः ॥६-२७-७॥।।
verses.transliteration: parvateṣu ca ye kecid viṣameṣu nadīṣu ca ।ete tvām abhivartante rājann ṛṣkāḥ sudāruṇāḥ ॥6-27-7॥।।

translations.english: "O King! Standing like dark clouds, black in colour like collyrium, who are of unfailing valour in war, innumerable in numbers, like the small particles of sand on the other bank of ocean, who cannot be counted are moving towards you. They are from mountains, riverbanks, and difficult locations. Those highly ferocious Bears are advancing towards you."

verses.sloka: एषाम् मध्ये स्थितो राजन् भीम अक्षो भीम दर्शनः ।पर्जन्य इव जीमूतैः समन्तात् परिवारितः ॥६-२७-८॥।।
verses.transliteration: eṣām madhye sthito rājan bhīma akṣo bhīma darśanaḥ ।parjanya iva jīmūtaiḥ samantāt parivāritaḥ ॥6-27-8॥।।

translations.english: "O king! In the midst of these (Vanaras) stands one with frightening eyes and fearful looks, just like Parjanya (RainGod) is surrounded by clouds, is the Lord of all these Bears called Dhumra. He dwells at the great Rkshavana mountain drinking Narmada's (river) water."
translations.hindi: हे राजम्‌ ! इनमें से बहुत से तो पहाड़ों पर, बहुत से अटपट ( ऊँची 'नीचो ) जगहों सें और बहुत से नदियों के तटों पर रहा करते हैं । हे राजम्‌! ये सब अत्यन्त दारुण रीछ आपका सामना करने को तैयार हैं

verses.sloka: ऋक्षवन्तम् गिरि श्रेष्ठम् अध्यास्ते नर्मदाम् पिबन् ।सर्व ऋक्षाणाम् अधिपतिर् धूम्रो नाम एष यूथपः ॥६-२७-९॥।।
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣavantam giri śreṣṭham adhyāste narmadām piban ।sarva ṛkṣāṇām adhipatir dhūmro nāma eṣa yūthapaḥ ॥6-27-9॥।।

translations.english: "O king! In the midst of these (Vanaras) stands one with frightening eyes and fearful looks, just like Parjanya (RainGod) is surrounded by clouds, is the Lord of all these Bears called Dhumra. He dwells at the great Rkshavana mountain drinking Narmada's (river) water."

verses.sloka: यवीयान् अस्य तु भ्राता पश्य एनम् पर्वत उपमम्भ्रात्रा समानो रूपेण विशिष्टस् तु पराक्रमे ॥६-२७-१०॥।।
verses.transliteration: yavīyān asya tu bhrātā paśya enam parvata upamambhrātrā samāno rūpeṇa viśiṣṭas tu parākrame ॥6-27-10॥।।

translations.english: "See this one like a mountain, he is the brother of Dhumra. Even though he is similar to his brother in body form and his valour is great. As such he is superior among leaders. He is called Jambavan, one of valourous deeds, devoted to elders and intolerant in killing."

verses.sloka: स एष जाम्बवान् नाम महायूथप यूथपः ।प्रशान्तो गुरु वर्ती च सम्प्रहारेष्व् अमर्षणः ॥६-२७-११॥।।
verses.transliteration: sa eṣa jāmbavān nāma mahāyūthapa yūthapaḥ ।praśānto guru vartī ca samprahāreṣv amarṣaṇaḥ ॥6-27-11॥।।

translations.english: "See this one like a mountain, he is the brother of Dhumra. Even though he is similar to his brother in body form and his valour is great. As such he is superior among leaders. He is called Jambavan, one of valourous deeds, devoted to elders and intolerant in killing."
translations.hindi: इसको देखिये, यह इसका छोटा भाई, पवत की तरह विशाल शरीरघारी है और अपने बड़े भाई जैसा ही रूप वाला दै | किन्तु पराक्रम में अपने भाई से बढ़ कर है

verses.sloka: एतेन साह्यम् सुमहत् कृतम् शक्रस्य धीमता ।देव असुरे जाम्बवता लब्धाः च बहवो वराः ॥६-२७-१२॥।।
verses.transliteration: etena sāhyam sumahat kṛtam śakrasya dhīmatā ।deva asure jāmbavatā labdhāḥ ca bahavo varāḥ ॥6-27-12॥।।

translations.english: "His assistance was given to Indra in the war between Devas and demons and in turn he obtained many boons."

verses.sloka: आरुह्य पर्वत अग्रेभ्यो महाअभ्र विपुलाः शिलाः ।मुन्चन्ति विपुल आकारा न मृत्योर् उद्विजन्ति च ॥६-२७-१३॥।।
verses.transliteration: āruhya parvata agrebhyo mahāabhra vipulāḥ śilāḥ ।muncanti vipula ākārā na mṛtyor udvijanti ca ॥6-27-13॥।।

translations.english: Appearing with hairybody glowing like fire like the Rakshasas and demons, many of them in huge form are climbing mountain peaks without caring for death and go about throwing rocks.
translations.hindi: जब्र देवासुर-संत्राम हुआ 'था,'तब उस बुद्धिमान ने देवराज क्री बडी सहायता की थी और 'उस सहायता के उपलक्ष्य म उसने बहत से वरदान भौ पाए थे

verses.sloka: राक्षसानाम् च सदृशाः पिशाचानाम् च रोमशाः ।एतस्य सैन्ये बहवो विचरन्ति अग्नि तेजसः ॥६-२७-१४॥।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasānām ca sadṛśāḥ piśācānām ca romaśāḥ ।etasya sainye bahavo vicaranti agni tejasaḥ ॥6-27-14॥।।

translations.english: Appearing with hairybody glowing like fire like the Rakshasas and demons, many of them in huge form are climbing mountain peaks without caring for death and go about throwing rocks.
translations.hindi: इसकी सेना के बड़े बड़े आकार के रीछ पवतरिखर पर चढ़ कर, वहाँ से बड़ी भारी भारी शिलायें फेंकते हैं ओर मौत से भी नहीं डरते

verses.sloka: यम् त्व् एनम् अभिसम्रब्धम् प्लवमानम् इव स्थितम् ।प्रेक्षन्ते वानराः सर्वे स्थितम् यूथप यूथपम् ॥६-२७-१५॥।।
verses.transliteration: yam tv enam abhisamrabdham plavamānam iva sthitam ।prekṣante vānarāḥ sarve sthitam yūthapa yūthapam ॥6-27-15॥।।

translations.english: "O king! This Lord of monkeys, whom whether he is jumping like monkeys or standing is the leader of the leaders, whom the monkeys are looking at standing is called Dhamba, a mighty powerful, fearsome leader and Lord of monkeys. He is surrounded by a strong army like the thousand eyed Indra."
translations.hindi: उसके शारीर में बड़े बड़े बाल हैं, वे राक्षस और पिशाचों की तरह क्रररच भाव हैं। जाम्बवान की अग्नि के समान तेजसम्पन्न बड़ी सेना है, जो इधर.उधर विचरा करती हे

verses.sloka: एष राजन् सहस्र अक्षम् पर्युपास्ते हरि ईश्वरः ।बलेन बल सम्पन्नो रम्भो नाम एष यूथपः ॥६-२७-१६॥।।
verses.transliteration: eṣa rājan sahasra akṣam paryupāste hari īśvaraḥ ।balena bala sampanno rambho nāma eṣa yūthapaḥ ॥6-27-16॥।।

translations.english: "O king! This Lord of monkeys, whom whether he is jumping like monkeys or standing is the leader of the leaders, whom the monkeys are looking at standing is called Dhamba, a mighty powerful, fearsome leader and Lord of monkeys. He is surrounded by a strong army like the thousand eyed Indra."

verses.sloka: यः स्थितम् योजने शैलम् गच्चन् पार्श्वेन सेवते ।ऊर्ध्वम् तथैव कायेन गतः प्राप्नोति योजनम् ॥६-२७-१७॥।।
verses.transliteration: yaḥ sthitam yojane śailam gaccan pārśvena sevate ।ūrdhvam tathaiva kāyena gataḥ prāpnoti yojanam ॥6-27-17॥।।

translations.english: "He who stands at one yojana touches a mountain with his flanks, so also gets up and reaches a yojana height with his body, is Sannadana. He is the grandfather of Vanaras. There is no one who has a bigger body size than him among the four legged ones. He had fought war with Indra and is well known for not losing in the battle."
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌ ! यह वानरराज इन्द्र के पास रहने बाला है । देखिये बड़ी भारी सेना को साथ शिये .हुए यह दर्भ नामक यूथप है

verses.sloka: यस्मान् न परमम् रूपम् चतुष्पादेषु विद्यते ।श्रुतः सम्नादनो नाम वानराणाम् पितामहः ॥६-२७-१८॥।।
verses.transliteration: yasmān na paramam rūpam catuṣpādeṣu vidyate ।śrutaḥ samnādano nāma vānarāṇām pitāmahaḥ ॥6-27-18॥।।

translations.english: "He who stands at one yojana touches a mountain with his flanks, so also gets up and reaches a yojana height with his body, is Sannadana. He is the grandfather of Vanaras. There is no one who has a bigger body size than him among the four legged ones. He had fought war with Indra and is well known for not losing in the battle."
translations.hindi: यह एक योजन के अन्तर पर स्थित पर्वेत की बगल से कूद जाता है तथा उछुल कर आक्राशमाग से एक योजन तक चला जात है। अथवा जिसके गमनकाल में एक एक कदम में एक एक योजन के पवत पार्श्वस्थ अर्थात्‌ अत्यन्त निकटबती हो जाते हें और जो शरीर से उछलने पर एक) कुलांच में एक योजन कूद जाता है । अर्थात्‌ इसके शरीर की ऊँचाई एक योजन की है

verses.sloka: येन युद्धम् तदा दत्तम् रणे शक्रस्य धीमता ।पराजयः च न प्राप्तः सो अयम् यूथप यूथपः ॥६-२७-१९॥।।
verses.transliteration: yena yuddham tadā dattam raṇe śakrasya dhīmatā ।parājayaḥ ca na prāptaḥ so ayam yūthapa yūthapaḥ ॥6-27-19॥।।

translations.english: "He who stands at one yojana touches a mountain with his flanks, so also gets up and reaches a yojana height with his body, is Sannadana. He is the grandfather of Vanaras. There is no one who has a bigger body size than him among the four legged ones. He had fought war with Indra and is well known for not losing in the battle."

verses.sloka: यस्य विक्रममाणस्य शक्रस्य इव पराक्रमः ।एष गन्धर्व कन्यायाम् उत्पन्नः कृष्ण वर्त्मना ॥६-२७-२०॥।।
verses.transliteration: yasya vikramamāṇasya śakrasya iva parākramaḥ ।eṣa gandharva kanyāyām utpannaḥ kṛṣṇa vartmanā ॥6-27-20॥।।

translations.english: "His valour is equal to that of Indra. He is born to Gandharva, a maiden of the god of fire. He was created for the sake of assisting gods in the war between gods and demons."
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्डे (र इसने बुद्धिमान इन्द्र के साथ युद्ध किस्ना, परन्तु हारा नहीं--से। यह भी यूथपतियों का सरदार है

verses.sloka: तत्र देवासुरे युद्धे साह्यार्थम् त्रिदिवौकसाम् ।यत्र वैश्रवणो राजा जम्बूमुपनिषेवते ॥६-२७-२१॥।।
verses.transliteration: tatra devāsure yuddhe sāhyārtham tridivaukasām ।yatra vaiśravaṇo rājā jambūmupaniṣevate ॥6-27-21॥।।

translations.english: "O King of Rakshasas! This Vanara who is exceptional among Vanaras, a commander of troops by name Krathana, who is not boastful in wars, lives on Kailas, the king of mountains which is frequented by many Kinnaras, on which your brother king Kubera son of Vysravana stays under Jambu tree and strolls for his pleasure."
translations.hindi: यह पराक्रम में इन्द्र के समान है । यह गन्धर्वेकन्या के गर्भ से अग्नि द्वारा उत्पन्न हुआ है

verses.sloka: यो राजा पर्वत इन्द्राणाम् बहु किम्नर सेविनाम् ।विहार सुखदो नित्यम् भ्रातुस् ते राक्षस अधिप ॥६-२७-२२॥।।
verses.transliteration: yo rājā parvata indrāṇām bahu kimnara sevinām ।vihāra sukhado nityam bhrātus te rākṣasa adhipa ॥6-27-22॥।।

translations.english: "O King of Rakshasas! This Vanara who is exceptional among Vanaras, a commander of troops by name Krathana, who is not boastful in wars, lives on Kailas, the king of mountains which is frequented by many Kinnaras, on which your brother king Kubera son of Vysravana stays under Jambu tree and strolls for his pleasure."
translations.hindi: देवासुर संग्राम में देवताओं की सहायता करने के लिए यह्‌ उत्पन्न किआ गया था । यह बलवान वानरश्रेछ उस पवत पर रहता है, जो पव॑तों का राजा है, जिसके ऊपर अनेक किन्नर रहा करते हैं और जिप्त पर तुम्हारे भाई राजा कुबेर को बिहार करने में आनन्द प्राप्त होता हे तथा जहाँ पर कुबेर जी जामुन के वृक्ष के नीचे बैठा करते हैं । इसका नाम क्रथन है और युद्ध में क्रियात्मक रूप से पराक्रम प्रदर्शन करता है, ( वाणी से अपने पराक्रम की डींगे नदीं हाँकता । ) यह भी एक यूथपति है.

verses.sloka: तत्र एष वसति श्रीमान् बलवान् वानर ऋषभः ।युद्धेष्व् अकत्थनो नित्यम् क्रथनो नाम यूथपः ॥६-२७-२३॥।।
verses.transliteration: tatra eṣa vasati śrīmān balavān vānara ṛṣabhaḥ ।yuddheṣv akatthano nityam krathano nāma yūthapaḥ ॥6-27-23॥।।

translations.english: "O King of Rakshasas! This Vanara who is exceptional among Vanaras, a commander of troops by name Krathana, who is not boastful in wars, lives on Kailas, the king of mountains which is frequented by many Kinnaras, on which your brother king Kubera son of Vysravana stays under Jambu tree and strolls for his pleasure."

verses.sloka: वृतः कोटि सहस्रेण हरीणाम् समवस्थितः ।एषैवाशम्सते लङ्काम् स्वेनानीकेन मर्दितुम् ॥६-२७-२४॥।।
verses.transliteration: vṛtaḥ koṭi sahasreṇa harīṇām samavasthitaḥ ।eṣaivāśamsate laṅkām svenānīkena marditum ॥6-27-24॥।।

translations.english: "He is surrounded with thousand crores of his Vanara force and with his own force he intends to crush Lanka."

verses.sloka: यो गङ्गामनुपर्येति त्रासयन् गजयूथपान् ।हस्तिनाम् वानराणाम् च पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन् ॥६-२७-२५॥।।
verses.transliteration: yo gaṅgāmanuparyeti trāsayan gajayūthapān ।hastinām vānarāṇām ca pūrvavairamanusmaran ॥6-27-25॥।।

translations.english: "There is one who roams around Ganga, frightening herds of elephants, remembering the earlier enmity between elephants and Vanaras. This leader of commanders goes about mountain caves, trees and mountains waging war with elephants."
translations.hindi: फन > > सँध्तविरी सेरे? २३४ सहस्र कोटि वानरों को साथ ले यह आया है । यह वीर भी केवल अपनी सेना ही से लङ्का को ध्वस्त करने की इच्छा रखता है

verses.sloka: एष यूथपतिर्नेता गर्जन् गिरिगुहाशयः ।गजान् रोधयते वन्यानारुजम्श्च महीरुहान् ॥६-२७-२६॥।।
verses.transliteration: eṣa yūthapatirnetā garjan giriguhāśayaḥ ।gajān rodhayate vanyānārujamśca mahīruhān ॥6-27-26॥।।

translations.english: "There is one who roams around Ganga, frightening herds of elephants, remembering the earlier enmity between elephants and Vanaras. This leader of commanders goes about mountain caves, trees and mountains waging war with elephants."
translations.hindi: जो हाथियों और वानरों के पूर्वकालीन पारस्परिक बैर का स्मरण कर, गजेन्द्रा के यूथपतियों को गङ्गा के निकट डराता है

verses.sloka: हरीणाम् वाहिनी मुख्यो नदीम् हैमवतीम् अनु ।उशीर बीजम् आश्रित्य पर्वतम् मन्दर उपमम् ॥६-२७-२७॥।।
verses.transliteration: harīṇām vāhinī mukhyo nadīm haimavatīm anu ।uśīra bījam āśritya parvatam mandara upamam ॥6-27-27॥।।

translations.english: "The chief of the army of monkeys and the excellent one among Vanaras revels on the mountain Usirabeejam like the mountain Mandara on the bank of river Hymavathi just as Indra in heaven."
translations.hindi: सो यह यूथपतियों का सरदार है और घूमफिर कर अर्थात्‌ ढंढाढूंढ कर गिरिगुहाओं में रहने वाले गर्जो, जंगली वृक्षा ओर पहाड़ों से लडाता हे। अर्थात्‌ गर्जा को उठा कर वृक्षों पर दे मारता हे और वृक्षों को उखाड़ कर गजों पर पटक देता हे । इसी प्रकार पवतो पर हाथियों को पटक देता है ओर पर्वत हाथियों पर

verses.sloka: रमते वानर श्रेष्ठो दिवि शक्र इव स्वयम् ।एनम् शत सहस्राणाम् सहस्रम् अभिवर्तते ॥६-२७-२८॥।।
verses.transliteration: ramate vānara śreṣṭho divi śakra iva svayam ।enam śata sahasrāṇām sahasram abhivartate ॥6-27-28॥।।

translations.english: "Thousand lakhs of mighty strong Vanaras who are proud of their valour and prowess roaring like lions follow him."
translations.hindi: यह बानरों की सेना का मुखिया समभा जाता है, यह पवतो- ततम मन्दराचल के उवीरशीज नामक पंबेत पर स्वग में इन्द्र की ` तरह रहता दै । इसके अधीन कई लाख वानर हैं

verses.sloka: वीर्यविक्रमदृप्तानाम् नर्दताम् बाहुशालिनाम् ।स एष नेता न्हैतेषाम् वानराणाम् महात्मनम् ॥६-२७-२९॥।।
verses.transliteration: vīryavikramadṛptānām nardatām bāhuśālinām ।sa eṣa netā nhaiteṣām vānarāṇām mahātmanam ॥6-27-29॥।।

translations.english: "He alone is the leader of the great Vanaras, O king. He is called Pramathi, a commander and a difficult one to resist."
translations.hindi: पाठान्तरे“ दीर्घ लाङगूलमाश्रिता; | २३० युद्धकाण्डे जिसकी पूछ के बाल चिकने ल॑वे आर नड़ सघन हैं. तथा जिनकी रंगत, लाल, पीली, घुमैली, सफेद हैं आर जों पूछ के इंधर उधर छिटक हुए बड़े भयङ्कर जान पड़ते ह

verses.sloka: स एष दुर्मर्षणो राजन् प्रमाथी नाम यूथपः ।वातेन इव उद्धतम् मेघम् यम् एनम् अनुपश्यसि ॥६-२७-३०॥।।
verses.transliteration: sa eṣa durmarṣaṇo rājan pramāthī nāma yūthapaḥ ।vātena iva uddhatam megham yam enam anupaśyasi ॥6-27-30॥।।

translations.english: "You see him (Pramathi) who resembles a cloud risen up by the wind you may also see the reddish brown dust particles lifted up by excessive whirling of the wind all over and also the furious Vanara army moving swiftly."
translations.hindi: इसकी सेना के वीर अपने बलपराक्रम के अभिमान में चूर हो, गरजा करते हैं| यह वानर उन संब बलवान वानरों का नायक है

verses.sloka: अनीकमपि सम्रब्धम् वानराणाम् तरस्विनाम् ।उद्धूतमरुणाभासम् पवनेन समन्ततः ॥६-२७-३१॥।।
verses.transliteration: anīkamapi samrabdham vānarāṇām tarasvinām ।uddhūtamaruṇābhāsam pavanena samantataḥ ॥6-27-31॥।।

translations.english: "You see him (Pramathi) who resembles a cloud risen up by the wind you may also see the reddish brown dust particles lifted up by excessive whirling of the wind all over and also the furious Vanara army moving swiftly."
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌! इधर देखिये, वायु से प्रेरित मेघ की तरह जो . दिखलाई दे रहा है, सो यह बड़ा दुर्धेषे वानर है। इसका नाम प्रमाथी है और यह भी यूथपति हे

verses.sloka: विवर्तमानम् बहुशो यत्र एतद् बहुलम् रजः ।एते असित मुखा घोरा गो लान्गूला महाबलाः ॥६-२७-३२॥।।
verses.transliteration: vivartamānam bahuśo yatra etad bahulam rajaḥ ।ete asita mukhā ghorā go lāngūlā mahābalāḥ ॥6-27-32॥।।

translations.english: "These hundred and hundred thousand black monkeys with a tail like that of a cow called Golangulas, endowed with black coloured face, fearsome and with extraordinary strength, watching the bridge constructed, surround Gavaksha the leader, who himself is a Golangula and of great speed. They intend to demolish Lanka with their vigour."

verses.sloka: शतम् शत सहस्राणि दृष्ट्वा वै सेतु बन्धनम् ।गो लान्गूलम् महावेगम् गव अक्षम् नाम यूथपम् ॥६-२७-३३॥।।
verses.transliteration: śatam śata sahasrāṇi dṛṣṭvā vai setu bandhanam ।go lāngūlam mahāvegam gava akṣam nāma yūthapam ॥6-27-33॥।।

translations.english: "These hundred and hundred thousand black monkeys with a tail like that of a cow called Golangulas, endowed with black coloured face, fearsome and with extraordinary strength, watching the bridge constructed, surround Gavaksha the leader, who himself is a Golangula and of great speed. They intend to demolish Lanka with their vigour."
translations.hindi: बहुत सी धूल का बवंडर वह रहा है । ये काले मुख के भयङ्कर महाबली गोलाङ्ग,ल

verses.sloka: परिवार्य अभिवर्तन्ते लंकाम् मर्दितुम् ओजसा ।भ्रमर आचरिता यत्र सर्व काम फल द्रुमाः ॥६-२७-३४॥।।
verses.transliteration: parivārya abhivartante laṁkām marditum ojasā ।bhramara ācaritā yatra sarva kāma phala drumāḥ ॥6-27-34॥।।

translations.english: "O king! Where the trees give fruit in all seasons which is inhabited by honeybees, whose leaves shine similar to that of Sunshine, where birds animals and all ever shining in golden colour of the Sun, where sages and great souls reside without leaving where trees always yield tasty fruits and have valuable honey in such a delightful golden mountain Vanara leader named Kesari, the chief of all chief Vanaras revels."
translations.hindi: लाखों की संख्या में सेतु के ऊपर देख पड़ते हैं, उनका यूथपति गवाक्ष हे जो बड़ा वेगवान है

verses.sloka: यम् सूर्य तुल्य वर्ण आभम् अनुपर्येति पर्वतम् ।यस्य भासा सदा भान्ति तद् वर्णा मृग पक्षिणः ॥६-२७-३५॥।।
verses.transliteration: yam sūrya tulya varṇa ābham anuparyeti parvatam ।yasya bhāsā sadā bhānti tad varṇā mṛga pakṣiṇaḥ ॥6-27-35॥।।

translations.english: "O king! Where the trees give fruit in all seasons which is inhabited by honeybees, whose leaves shine similar to that of Sunshine, where birds animals and all ever shining in golden colour of the Sun, where sages and great souls reside without leaving where trees always yield tasty fruits and have valuable honey in such a delightful golden mountain Vanara leader named Kesari, the chief of all chief Vanaras revels."
translations.hindi: इसी गवाक्ष युथपति को घेरे हुए समस्त गोलाङ्गल, लक्का को अपने वल से ध्वस्त करना चाहते हें । जहाँ पर भोरे सदा मँडराया करते हें । और जहाँ वृक्षों में सदा फल लगे रहते हैं

verses.sloka: यस्य प्रस्थम् महात्मानो न त्यजन्ति महर्षयः ।सर्वकामफला वृक्षाः सर्वे फलसमन्विताः ॥६-२७-३६॥।।
verses.transliteration: yasya prastham mahātmāno na tyajanti maharṣayaḥ ।sarvakāmaphalā vṛkṣāḥ sarve phalasamanvitāḥ ॥6-27-36॥।।

translations.english: "O king! Where the trees give fruit in all seasons which is inhabited by honeybees, whose leaves shine similar to that of Sunshine, where birds animals and all ever shining in golden colour of the Sun, where sages and great souls reside without leaving where trees always yield tasty fruits and have valuable honey in such a delightful golden mountain Vanara leader named Kesari, the chief of all chief Vanaras revels."
translations.hindi: सूये अपना वर्ण बाला समझ, जिस पर्वेत की सदा परिक्रमा किआ करते हैं और जहाँ की अरुण कान्ति से उस स्थानवासी समस्त मृग और पक्षी उसी रंग जैसे दैख पड़ते है

verses.sloka: मधूनि च महार्हाणि यस्मिन् पर्वतसत्तमे ।तत्र एष रमते राजन् रम्ये कान्चन पर्वते ॥६-२७-३७॥।।
verses.transliteration: madhūni ca mahārhāṇi yasmin parvatasattame ।tatra eṣa ramate rājan ramye kāncana parvate ॥6-27-37॥।।

translations.english: "O king! Where the trees give fruit in all seasons which is inhabited by honeybees, whose leaves shine similar to that of Sunshine, where birds animals and all ever shining in golden colour of the Sun, where sages and great souls reside without leaving where trees always yield tasty fruits and have valuable honey in such a delightful golden mountain Vanara leader named Kesari, the chief of all chief Vanaras revels."
translations.hindi: के शि जी महार रित्याग नहीं करते जिसके शिखर को महात्मा महर्षि कभी परित्याग जहाँ पर सर्वकामना पूरी करने वाले इक्ष सदा फला करते हैं

verses.sloka: मुख्यो वानर मुख्यानाम् केसरी नाम यूथपः ।षष्टिर् गिरि सहस्राणाम् रम्याः कान्चन पर्वताः ॥६-२७-३८॥।।
verses.transliteration: mukhyo vānara mukhyānām kesarī nāma yūthapaḥ ।ṣaṣṭir giri sahasrāṇām ramyāḥ kāncana parvatāḥ ॥6-27-38॥।।

translations.english: "O sinless king! there are sixty thousand golden mountains. In the midst of them is this golden mountain just as you are in the midst of the Rakshasas. On the last mountain the Vanaras with brown coloured face, white face, coppery red face and yellow face like honey with sharp teeth like lions, who have nails as weapons, four toothed ones like lions, fearsome ones like tiger, dangerous to approach, all of them like serpents with flaming venomous tongues, with long uplifted tails, like huge elephants in rut in mountain size, roaring like lions, thundering clouds, with round brownish red eyed ones, fearful while walking and causing appalling uproar all of them dwell on the last mountain. They are watching to demolish your Lanka as they look at it."
translations.hindi: पाठान्तरे “ सर्वकामफलद्रुमाः र २३८ युद्धका ए ओर जिस परेत श्रेष्ठ पर बढ़िया मधु आदि मोठे पदार्थ पन्न होते हैं, हे राजन्‌! उसी रमणीय काञ्चनमय पर्वत पर, वानरश्रष्ठां में मुख्य, केसरी नामक यूथपति रसता है। साठ हजार रमणीक काञ्चनमय पवतां के बीच सोवणि नामक पर्वत सब पवतों में वैसा ही श्रेष्ठ है जैसे कि, राक्षसो में आप पाप- रहित पीले, सफेइ,मधुपिङ्गल ( शहद की तरह पीले) रंग के लाल मुख वाले वानर

verses.sloka: तेषाम् मध्ये गिरि वरस् त्वम् इव अनघ रक्षसाम् ।तत्र एते कपिलाः श्वेतास् ताम्र आस्या मधु पिन्गलाः ॥६-२७-३९॥।।
verses.transliteration: teṣām madhye giri varas tvam iva anagha rakṣasām ।tatra ete kapilāḥ śvetās tāmra āsyā madhu pingalāḥ ॥6-27-39॥।।

translations.english: "O sinless king! there are sixty thousand golden mountains. In the midst of them is this golden mountain just as you are in the midst of the Rakshasas. On the last mountain the Vanaras with brown coloured face, white face, coppery red face and yellow face like honey with sharp teeth like lions, who have nails as weapons, four toothed ones like lions, fearsome ones like tiger, dangerous to approach, all of them like serpents with flaming venomous tongues, with long uplifted tails, like huge elephants in rut in mountain size, roaring like lions, thundering clouds, with round brownish red eyed ones, fearful while walking and causing appalling uproar all of them dwell on the last mountain. They are watching to demolish your Lanka as they look at it."

verses.sloka: निवसन्ति उत्तम गिरौ तीक्ष्ण दम्ष्ट्रा नख आयुधाः ।सिम्ह इव चतुर् दम्ष्ट्रा व्याघ्रा इव दुरासदाः ॥६-२७-४०॥।।
verses.transliteration: nivasanti uttama girau tīkṣṇa damṣṭrā nakha āyudhāḥ ।simha iva catur damṣṭrā vyāghrā iva durāsadāḥ ॥6-27-40॥।।

translations.english: "O sinless king! there are sixty thousand golden mountains. In the midst of them is this golden mountain just as you are in the midst of the Rakshasas. On the last mountain the Vanaras with brown coloured face, white face, coppery red face and yellow face like honey with sharp teeth like lions, who have nails as weapons, four toothed ones like lions, fearsome ones like tiger, dangerous to approach, all of them like serpents with flaming venomous tongues, with long uplifted tails, like huge elephants in rut in mountain size, roaring like lions, thundering clouds, with round brownish red eyed ones, fearful while walking and causing appalling uproar all of them dwell on the last mountain. They are watching to demolish your Lanka as they look at it."

verses.sloka: सर्वे वैश्वनर समा ज्वलित आशी विष उपमाः ।सुदीर्घ अन्चित लान्गूला मत्त मातम्ग सम्निभाः ॥६-२७-४१॥।।
verses.transliteration: sarve vaiśvanara samā jvalita āśī viṣa upamāḥ ।sudīrgha ancita lāngūlā matta mātamga samnibhāḥ ॥6-27-41॥।।

translations.english: "O sinless king! there are sixty thousand golden mountains. In the midst of them is this golden mountain just as you are in the midst of the Rakshasas. On the last mountain the Vanaras with brown coloured face, white face, coppery red face and yellow face like honey with sharp teeth like lions, who have nails as weapons, four toothed ones like lions, fearsome ones like tiger, dangerous to approach, all of them like serpents with flaming venomous tongues, with long uplifted tails, like huge elephants in rut in mountain size, roaring like lions, thundering clouds, with round brownish red eyed ones, fearful while walking and causing appalling uproar all of them dwell on the last mountain. They are watching to demolish your Lanka as they look at it."
translations.hindi: उस पवतोत्तम पर रहते हैं। उनके शस्त्र हैं उनके पेने पेने दाँत और नख | सिंह की तरह इनके चौघड़े हैं और व्याघ्र की तरह ये दुधष हैं

verses.sloka: महापर्वत सम्काशा महाजीमूत निस्वनाः ।वृत्तपिङ्गलनेत्रा हि महाभीमगतिस्वनाः ॥६-२७-४२॥।।
verses.transliteration: mahāparvata samkāśā mahājīmūta nisvanāḥ ।vṛttapiṅgalanetrā hi mahābhīmagatisvanāḥ ॥6-27-42॥।।

translations.english: "O sinless king! there are sixty thousand golden mountains. In the midst of them is this golden mountain just as you are in the midst of the Rakshasas. On the last mountain the Vanaras with brown coloured face, white face, coppery red face and yellow face like honey with sharp teeth like lions, who have nails as weapons, four toothed ones like lions, fearsome ones like tiger, dangerous to approach, all of them like serpents with flaming venomous tongues, with long uplifted tails, like huge elephants in rut in mountain size, roaring like lions, thundering clouds, with round brownish red eyed ones, fearful while walking and causing appalling uproar all of them dwell on the last mountain. They are watching to demolish your Lanka as they look at it."
translations.hindi: यह सब के सब अभि की तरह उप्र हैं और कुपित सर्प के विष की तरह महाभयङ्कर हैं । इनकी बड़ी लंबी और उमठवाँ पूंछ हैं और मतवाले हाथी की तरह ये चलते हें

verses.sloka: मर्दयन्तीव ते सर्वे तस्थुर्लङ्काम् समीक्ष्य ते ।एष चैषामधिपतिर्मध्ये तिष्ठति वीर्यवान् ॥६-२७-४३॥।।
verses.transliteration: mardayantīva te sarve tasthurlaṅkām samīkṣya te ।eṣa caiṣāmadhipatirmadhye tiṣṭhati vīryavān ॥6-27-43॥।।

translations.english: "O king! He who is known as Satabali, is a famous one on the earth, is a valiant hero, a leader. He stands in the middle aspiring for victory ever worshipping Sun. He alone with his army is intending to demolish Lanka."
translations.hindi: बड़े पवत की तरह लंबे तडंगे हैं और महामेघ की तरह गरजा करते हैं । उनकी गोल गोल पीली पोली आँखें हैं। वे बढी ही भयङ्कर गति वाले और डरावनी बोली बोलने वाले हैं

verses.sloka: जयार्थी नित्यमादित्यमुपतिष्ठति बुद्धिमान् ।नाम्ना पृथिव्याम् विख्यातो राजन् शत बली इति यः ॥६-२७-४४॥।।
verses.transliteration: jayārthī nityamādityamupatiṣṭhati buddhimān ।nāmnā pṛthivyām vikhyāto rājan śata balī iti yaḥ ॥6-27-44॥।।

translations.english: "O king! He who is known as Satabali, is a famous one on the earth, is a valiant hero, a leader. He stands in the middle aspiring for victory ever worshipping Sun. He alone with his army is intending to demolish Lanka."

verses.sloka: एष एव आशम्सते लंकाम् स्वेन अनीकेन मर्दितुम् ।विक्रान्तो बलवान् शूरः पौरुषे स्वे व्यवस्थितः ॥६-२७-४५॥।।
verses.transliteration: eṣa eva āśamsate laṁkām svena anīkena marditum ।vikrānto balavān śūraḥ pauruṣe sve vyavasthitaḥ ॥6-27-45॥।।

translations.english: "He is indomitable, strong and heroic. He will not give up his virility. For the pleasure of Rama, he will not feel pity for his life (he will give up his life)."

verses.sloka: रामप्रियार्थम् प्राणानाम् दयाम् न कुरुते हरिः ।गजो गव अक्षो गवयो नलो नीलः च वानरः ।एक एक एव यूथानाम् कोटिभिर् दशभिर् वृतः ॥६-२७-४६॥।।
verses.transliteration: rāmapriyārtham prāṇānām dayām na kurute hariḥ ।gajo gava akṣo gavayo nalo nīlaḥ ca vānaraḥ ।eka eka eva yūthānām koṭibhir daśabhir vṛtaḥ ॥6-27-46॥।।

translations.english: "Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Nila each of these Vanara leaders have ten crores of army under them."
translations.hindi: यह बुद्धिमान वानर विजय प्राप्त की इच्छा से नित्य सुय की आराधना किआ करता है और हे राजन्‌! इस संसार में यह शातंबली के नास से प्रसिद्ध है ॥ ४३९५४ 58 ६ हि ई एषे बाशंसते सङ्कां स्वेनानीकेन मदि तुम्‌ । विक्रान्तो बलवाञ्शूरः पौरुषे स्वे व्यस्थितः

verses.sloka: तथा अन्ये वानर श्रेष्ठा विन्ध्य पर्वत वासिनः ।न शक्यन्ते बहुत्वात् तु सम्ख्यातुम् लघु विक्रमाः ॥६-२७-४७॥।।
verses.transliteration: tathā anye vānara śreṣṭhā vindhya parvata vāsinaḥ ।na śakyante bahutvāt tu samkhyātum laghu vikramāḥ ॥6-27-47॥।।

translations.english: "So also, those best of Vanaras of many kinds residing in Vindhya mountain of great valour in large numbers is impossible to count."
translations.hindi: यह श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की प्रसन्नता सम्पादन करने के लिए अपने प्राणों को तुच्छ समझता है । हे राजन्‌ । गज, गवाक्ष, गवय, नल और नील नामक जो बान्र हैँ

verses.sloka: सर्वे महाराज महाप्रभावाः ।सर्वे महाशैल निकाश कायाः ।सर्वे समर्थाः पृथिवीम् क्षणेन ।कर्तुम् प्रविध्वस्त विकीर्ण शैलाम् ॥६-२७-४८॥
verses.transliteration: sarve mahārāja mahāprabhāvāḥ ।sarve mahāśaila nikāśa kāyāḥ ।sarve samarthāḥ pṛthivīm kṣaṇena ।kartum pravidhvasta vikīrṇa śailām ॥6-27-48॥

translations.english: "O, Monarch! All of them are highly prominent, their stature equal to high hills and all of them are capable of levelling the earth by uprooting and razing its mountains to the ground in a moment." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेसप्तविंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the twenty seventh sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
